en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a rustic half‑timbered inn or guesthouse in a wooded setting. Two adjoining buildings with timber framing, brick lower walls, and shuttered windows stand among tall trees. Simple wooden tables and benches are placed outside on a dirt courtyard, suggesting an outdoor beer garden or café. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing—men in work aprons or suits, and women in long skirts and aprons—stand near the entrances and along the building front. Small wall signs and posters are visible on the façade, but the text is mostly too small to read.
